column1: # Phase 18's gate build pointer, read by scripts/rowsb.sh (2026-10-20, the resume session). It replaces the files
# gate-build-2 / gate-build-3 that rowsb.sh read from a finished session's scratchpad. One `current` row: the APK every
# device row installs and asserts, and the commit its source is (the JVM frame compiles that commit, in a worktree made
# by scripts/src_worktree.sh). `prior` rows: earlier gate builds whose rows still stand (E12 and E20 accept a row's
# latest run when it is stamped with the current build or one of these). The APK file itself is git-ignored and kept
